name: LabelMakerList
job: Present tags, services or ingredients as embossed label-maker strips that print out one after another with a tiny cut
visitor_action: none (prints in view); hover tilts a strip
motion: strips feed out and clip with a small snap, staggered (reduced-motion: all strips in place)
art_direction: Workshop shelf: glossy cobalt and cream tape strips, white raised letters, slight curl at the cut end, pegboard-grey ground
